map.色浆比例 = 色浆质量 ÷ 乳胶漆质量 × 100%: Pigment ratio = pigment mass ÷ latex paint mass × 100%
map.• 浅色色浆比例约 0.3-1%，中色 1-3%，深色 3-8%: • Light pigment ratio about 0.3–1%, medium 1–3%, dark 3–8%
map.• 调色遵循\"由浅入深\"原则，少量多次添加，充分搅匀: • Follow the "light to dark" principle, add small amounts multiple times, mix thoroughly
map.• 同一空间建议一次调够用量，避免二次调色色差: • For the same space, tint enough at once to avoid color difference from a second batch
map.• 深色乳胶漆建议选用配套深色基础漆，遮盖力更好: • For dark latex paint, use a matching dark base paint for better coverage
map.• 配方为参考比例，实际效果受基础漆、色浆品牌影响，请先小样试色: • The formula is a reference ratio; actual effect depends on base paint and pigment brand, so test a sample first

map.墙面浅色补漆：已知基漆 5kg，选浅色比例 0.5%，得色浆 ≈ 5×0.005: Wall light-color touch-up: with 5 kg base paint and light ratio 0.5%, pigment ≈ 5 × 0.005 = 0.025 kg; confirm with a sample before bulk.
map.中深色背景墙：深色比例升至 3%–8%，量大时建议分批加浆并搅拌后比对色卡。: Medium-dark accent wall: dark ratio rises to 3%–8%; for large amounts, add pigment in batches and compare with the color card after stirring.
map.多桶同色复配：按总基漆质量统一折算色浆，避免分批比例漂移导致色差。: Multi-bucket same-color mixing: convert pigment uniformly by total base paint mass to avoid ratio drift and color difference across batches.
map.示例：基漆 10kg，目标中色，色浆比例取 2%。\n• 色浆量 ≈ 10 ×: Example: base paint 10 kg, target medium, pigment ratio 2%.
map.浅色 0.3%–1%、中色 1%–3%、深色 3%–8%，具体看色浆浓度与基漆白: Light 0.3%–1%, medium 1%–3%, dark 3%–8%, depending on pigment concentration and base paint whiteness.
map.不同批次基漆、含水量、搅拌不均都会偏色，务必先小样比对色卡再大批。: Different base batches, water content and uneven stirring all cause color shift; always compare a sample with the color card before bulk.
map.深色为什么费浆？: Why does dark use more pigment?
map.深色遮盖力差、需更多色浆饱和，比例显著更高；建议分次加浆避免一次过深。: Dark colors have poor coverage and need more pigment to saturate, so the ratio is significantly higher; add pigment in stages to avoid going too dark at once.
